name: claude-code-prod-starter
description: Type your idea, get a shipped PR. The Claude Code plugin that orchestrates 9 agents, 14 skills, and 11 commands automatically. /go <one sentence> runs the full SDLC end-to-end — auto-bootstraps PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, detects intent and blast radius, picks light or full mode, spawns specialist agents at the right moments, pauses only at meaningful checkpoints (spec, plan, ship). Six token-discipline hooks land 35-55% real-world savings vs naive use. Includes /autopilot 9-gate governance for high-stakes work, /diagnose for transparency, /compress for surgical context compaction, and a 5-doc onboarding path. Project-agnostic. Zero-config for noobs; surgical control for pros.
